name: ianhobbs/kirby-cloudflare-tools
description: Kirby CMS plugin — a Cloudflare control panel in the Panel: cache purge, zone settings, security, SSL/TLS, DNS and traffic analytics on any Cloudflare plan, including Free

suggest.johannschopplich/kirby-helpers: Loads the API token and zone ID from a .env file kept outside the web root (Env::load + env())
suggest.bnomei/kirby-janitor: Adds Panel buttons for the cloudflare-tools:purge and cloudflare-tools:check commands
